Corrected to Industrials / Commercial & Professional Services / Professional Services, matching this same person's/company's own established treatment of professional-services firms elsewhere in this ticker (McKinsey & Company) and the corpus precedent for HEAD (HeadHunter, whose company-level GICS in this same taxonomy is also Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services). No new source needed — same already-cited annual report bio card, general-knowledge business-type correction (same class of fix as the McKinsey/Goldman Sachs corrections in gics_quality_round_20260728.md). Quality pass 2026-08-02: qualification_degree misclassification fixed — the certified-corporate-secretary credential (Национальное объединение корпоративных секретарей) was coded 'Unknown' although the raw 'qualification' field already states 'сертифицированный корпоративный секретарь' (certified corporate secretary); corrected to 'Professional certification' per the fixed enum. No new source needed, already drawn from the cited annual report bio card. Статус сертифицированного корпоративного секретаря сохранен как дополнительная профессиональная квалификация, не как ученая степень. Опыт работы заменен по визуально проверенной карточке годового отчета; прежние записи про Право.ру и X5 Retail Group противоречили отчету. Научные публикации, патенты и h-index не подтверждены. Quality-review verification re-check (2026-08-02, second pass): spot-checked round 1's own output and found two issues, both fixed directly (no content deleted, no new unresolved gaps): (a) ООО «Экстраверт» (Школлер) — round 1 set sector/industry_group to Materials/Materials but left industry null, contradicting round 1's own notes claim of 'Paper & Forest Products'; industry corrected to match, no new research needed (same already-cited audit-it.ru source). (b) Eversheds Sutherland/Birch Legal (Алеева) — a law firm mislabeled Consumer Discretionary/Specialty Retail, inherited unchanged from git HEAD and missed by both the 2026-07-28 GICS round and round 1; corrected to Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services (matching this ticker's own McKinsey classification and the corpus's HEAD-ticker precedent). All other GICS triples in this file were re-validated programmatically against the 74-row gics_taxonomy.json and all now match a valid row exactly. Quality pass round 1 (2026-08-02): see research_notes/VSEH/quality_pass_round1_20260802.md for full detail. Step 0 baseline check: current file was byte-for-byte identical (modulo CRLF/LF) to git HEAD (commit f973022) — no prior-round regression to restore. GICS corrections (2): АНО «Поколение» (Гребенюк) was wrongly labeled Consumer Discretionary/Specialty Retail — it is a nonprofit teen-mentorship program, corrected to null/null/null; ООО «Первый КМЦ» (Ершов) was wrongly labeled Consumer Discretionary/Specialty Retail — registry confirms it is a hospital/medical-center entity (OKVED 86.10), corrected to Health Care/Health Care Equipment & Services/Health Care Providers & Services. Honest-gap follow-up resolved (5): ООО «Ви.Тех» (Кузин) → Information Technology/Software & Services/Software; ООО «Вирент» (Иванов) → Consumer Discretionary/Consumer Services/Diversified Consumer Services; ООО «Байсон» (Ершов) → Consumer Discretionary/Consumer Discretionary Distribution & Retail (New Name)/Specialty Retail; ООО «Экстраверт» (Школлер) → Materials/Materials/Paper & Forest Products; ООО «Стройинвест» (Гребенюк) → Real Estate/Real Estate Management & Development (New)/Real Estate Management & Development (New Code) — all backed by fresh company-registry sources added to each entry's sources[]. Honest-gap follow-up attempted, still unresolved/left null (7): ООО «СПБ», ООО «Резалтинг» (Гребенюк); Dealrose Limited (confirmed correctly-non-classifiable Askona holding vehicle), HEILCROFT LIMITED (Ершов); education/patronymic for Грунин Дмитрий, Агранович Мария, Куприянов Иван, Гришков Сергей, Денисенко Сергей — fresh queries logged in each person's notes field and in the round file, not repeated. qualification_degree misclassifications fixed (2, no new research needed): Безумов (BSc/MSc coded 'Unknown' despite explicit degree text → Bachelor's degree/Master's degree); Алеева (certified-corporate-secretary credential coded 'Unknown' → Professional certification). No genuine notes-vs-JSON inconsistency (per the strict definition — conflicting sourced values) was found this round; the only internal inconsistency was the qualification_degree/enum miscoding above, resolved from already-cited source text without new research. Nothing was deleted; all previously confirmed facts, descriptions, and source citations were preserved and cross-checked longer/equal versus git HEAD.
